settings.tagline: Fast, free apps built for real life.
settings.heroTitle: Apps built to move with you
settings.heroSubtitle: A connected ecosystem of lightweight, free apps and tools for Android, desktop and the web. Small downloads, instant launches, no accounts.
settings.aboutText:
Link Ecosystem Developers is an independent studio building lightweight software for everyday life. We started with a simple frustration: most apps are heavy, noisy and full of things nobody asked for.

So we build the opposite. Small installs. Fast launches. No account walls, no ad networks and no analytics SDKs buried in the package. Every app shares the same design language, so learning one means you already understand the rest.

We design for real conditions - entry-level phones, metered data and unreliable connections - because that is how most of the world actually uses software. If an app cannot open in under a second, it does not ship.

Everything we publish is free to download. The apps live on our external server; this site is the catalogue, the release notes archive and the front door to the ecosystem.
settings.footerText: © 2026 Link Ecosystem Developers. All rights reserved.
settings.metaDescription: Link Ecosystem Developers build fast, free and lightweight apps and tools for Android, Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS and the web.

apps.name: Link Stream
apps.tagline: A featherweight media player that opens instantly.
apps.description:
Link Stream plays almost any video or audio format without extra codec packs. It is built for low-end hardware first, so it launches in under a second even on older devices.

The library stays on your phone and is never uploaded anywhere. Subtitles, playback speed, gesture controls and picture-in-picture are all included, with no account and no ads.

This is a demo entry shipped with the site so you can preview the layout. Replace it with a real release by editing data/apps.json.
apps.changelog:
Added per-video subtitle offset controls
Improved battery usage during long playback
Fixed stutter on devices with 2 GB RAM
New gesture: swipe vertically for brightness
Updated translations for Swahili and French

apps.name: Link Toolkit
apps.tagline: Sixty small utilities in one clean install.
apps.description:
Link Toolkit bundles the utilities you reach for every week: unit and currency converters, a text case changer, a QR scanner, a colour picker, a stopwatch and more.

Every tool runs entirely on-device, so it keeps working with no connection. This demo entry has two download links, showing how the catalogue sends visitors to the details page when a release is available for more than one platform.
apps.changelog:
New unit converter categories
Dark mode polish and larger tap targets
Fixed rounding bug in the currency converter
Added keyboard shortcuts on desktop

apps.name: Link Vault
apps.tagline: Offline-first budgeting that never leaves your device.
apps.description:
Link Vault keeps budgets, recurring bills and savings goals in a local encrypted database. No sign-up, no cloud sync, no bank connections - just a clear picture of your money.

This demo entry is marked coming_soon, so the site shows a disabled download button and a release badge until you publish real links.
apps.changelog:
First public preview build
Local encrypted storage
Monthly budget envelopes
